module: Career tutorial step 2 ("moveOff"): learning to move off according to the gearbox mode set in step 1. Three modes (inferred from the gearboxMode setting and autoClutch): arcade, realistic_clutch (engage 1st gear then accelerate) and realistic_no_clutch (manual clutch, with recovery on engine stall). The step ends when the vehicle has moved at least 3 m, then activates 03basicManeuvers after 1 s.
notes: Thresholds: movement 3 m, throttle input 0.2, 1st gear = gearIndex 1.
A stall is detected by a change of ignitionLevel from 2 to 0 or 1 (no-clutch mode only).
The hooks are called by the tutorial runtime.

setup.desc: Called on activation: resets the state, activates the evalZone zone, registers the throttle_input, clutch, gearIndex, ignitionLevel notifications, reads the gearbox behavior (mainController/gearboxMode), chooses the mode, unlocks the gear change actions, unfreezes the vehicle and builds the task list.

onCareerTutorialLeftBounds.desc: Out-of-bounds hook: starts the step's out-of-bounds reset.

onUpdate.desc: Called every frame: reads the cached vehicle inputs, handles stalling, validates the objectives and advances to step 03 when the 3 m distance is reached.

cleanup.desc: Removes the out-of-bounds handler, unregisters the vehicle notifications and clears the task list.

onDebugMenu.desc: Displays the current mode and a button to skip the step (activates 03basicManeuvers).
